Bhayandar East, Mumbai – 401105 | 8689963668 | psharma.231995@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/pankaj-sharma-a16b4a1ab
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Detail-oriented finance professional with 6+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Trade Settlement, Reconciliation, and Client
Management. Proven expertise in Equity and OTC listed derivative settlement across DTCC and Euroclear. Hands-on experience in
SSI validation and maintenance, pre-matching, settlement fails, month-end closing, end-of-day balancing, reconciliation, and
CSDR-related controls. Strong track record of resolving settlement exceptions, coordinating with brokers and custodians, and
delivering accurate client reporting.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Trade Settlement (Equity & Derivatives)  OTC & Listed Derivatives  Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI)  SSI Validation &
Maintenance  CSDR Compliance  Reconciliation  Trade Confirmation & Pre-Matching  End-of-Day Balancing  Month-End Closing
 Middle & Back Office Operations  Client Reporting  SWIFT Messages  Broker & Custodian Coordination  Escalation
Management
WORK EXPERIENCE
Associate – Trade Settlement | BNY (Bank of New York)   Oct 2024 – Jan 2026
  Managed daily settlement of high-value Equity and OTC listed derivative products.
  Performed hands-on pre-matching and settlement activities, checking and ensuring SSI accuracy in counterparty SWIFT
 messages for trades across DTC and Euroclear markets and amending instructions when required.
 Maintained and updated Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) in ALERT, supporting accurate settlement and reducing
 instruction-related fails.
 Performed trade confirmation and pre-matching to reduce fails, overdraft charges, and CSDR penalties.
  Performed end-of-day balancing activities, validating settlement and cash/position records and investigating discrepancies before
 daily close.
 Supported month-end closing activities, completing required reconciliations, validations, and outstanding-item checks to ensure
 accurate and timely operational close.
 Liaised with trading desks, sales, IT teams, brokers, and custodians to ensure seamless end-to-end settlement processing.
  Resolved failing trades by coordinating with brokers and custodians on shorts, stock loans, and instruction mismatches.
  Monitored the group mailbox to ensure queries were actioned on time according to priority and SLA requirements.
 Real Estate Analyst (FTC) | MSCI   Jan 2024 – Jul 2024

 Generated monthly, quarterly, biannual, and annual benchmark reports for clients based on subscription packages.

  Delivered goal-based mutual fund guidance and resolved investment and operational queries.
